mechanism_findings.finding: Each place uses the same tiny SQLite schema: baustein(kennung,fassung,text,hash,angelegt,zweck) keyed by (kennung,fassung), plus nutzung(kennung,fassung,wann,zeichen). BEFORE UPDATE and BEFORE DELETE triggers abort mutations, forcing append-only version creation instead of destructive overwrite.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Useful historical precursor for versioned immutable instruction/procedure objects and audit history in UnifiedDB; scope identity should be explicit rather than inferred only from filename/database location.

mechanism_findings.finding: A1 stores a concrete numeric UI acceptance contract: idle 0 rAF and under 1% main-thread load with five spheres over two minutes; one impact animation <=4 ms/frame and <=900 ms; five simultaneous impacts <15% of one core; idle animations self-terminate; report numeric pass/fail per bound.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Preserve as historical measurable-acceptance style and possible UI/Clay performance lineage, not as a current universal threshold without target-hardware revalidation.

mechanism_findings.finding: A2 stores an external-generation contract that constrains a foreign model to standalone Python 3, numpy+PIL only, deterministic fixed seed, vectorized image computation, explicit argv output path, wrap-around/tileability, no post-normalization and code-only return.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Reusable pattern for Needle/tool delegation: external generation remains bounded by deterministic, executable, testable contracts rather than free-form trust.

mechanism_findings.finding: Chef.nutzung records ('schrift',2,...) even though Chef.baustein contains no corresponding schrift v2 row. The schema has no foreign key from usage to immutable block identity, so audit references can become orphaned while UPDATE/DELETE immutability still holds.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: UnifiedDB/Harness must test reference integrity and version existence independently of append-only immutability; append-only alone is insufficient provenance closure.

unifieddb: REUSE_WITH_ADAPTATION: immutable versioned objects plus separate usage history.
ADD TEST: every usage/provenance reference resolves to an existing versioned object or is explicitly external/tombstoned; do not rely on append-only triggers alone.
harness: REGRESSION: orphan usage reference should be detected/rejected or explicitly classified.
MEASUREMENT STYLE: preserve numeric acceptance bounds with measured pass/fail receipts, but re-freeze thresholds on project hardware.
needle: REUSE: bounded deterministic external-generation contracts with explicit dependencies/output constraints and executable verification.
claycode: SEMANTIC REQUIREMENT: versioned immutable procedure/instruction identities and usage receipts should be representable without destructive overwrite.
claygraph: A usage/activation edge must not imply its target exists or is authoritative; target-resolution/provenance status must remain explicit.

earned_work.reason: Unique historical mechanism preserved, but no row-level avoided-future-work calibration performed in this shard.
